description: Header file for the HIP9011/TPIC8101 driver, declaring functions and macros for hardware control and configuration related to the HIP9011 device.

methods.name: initHip9011
methods.description: Initializes the HIP9011 hardware and takes a shared logger object for logging purposes.

methods.name: setHip9011FrankensoPinout
methods.description: Configures pinout for the Frankenso board for HIP9011.

methods.name: hipAdcCallback
methods.description: Callback function for ADC sampling, called when an ADC sample is available.

methods.name: setHipGain
methods.description: Sets the gain level for the HIP9011 device.

methods.name: setHipBand
methods.description: Sets the bandwidth or frequency band for the HIP9011 device.

methods.name: setPrescalerAndSDO
methods.description: Configures the prescaler value and SDO pin for the HIP9011.

methods.name: setKnockThresh
methods.description: Sets the threshold for knock detection.

methods.name: setMaxKnockSubDeg
methods.description: Sets the maximum knock subtraction in degrees.
